World Conflicts.title: Deadly strike hits market in Yemen’s Taiz
World Conflicts.summary: A strike on a market in the Yemeni city of Taiz has killed at least seven people and wounded 40.

World Conflicts.title: Israeli strikes continue in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
World Conflicts.summary: An Israeli Apache helicopter struck a commercial centre near Mayfadoun in Southern Lebanon.

World Conflicts.title: Five arrested near UK RAF base over suspected explosives ‘terror’ plot
World Conflicts.summary: Five men have been arrested near RAF Fairford in the UK on suspicion of explosives and terrorism offences.
